analysis:
The only changed region in SSDPrefixCache.swift is evictOldestEntry (base lines 1772-1786, head 1772-1777, per the complete range map). Neither supplied unit contains that region. Unit :5 is base lines 1837-2191; unit :6 is head lines 1-656.

Base behavior, from the patch excerpt: evictOldestEntry snapshots index.oldestEntries() and calls retireIndexedEntries per victim. It returns 0 immediately on externalChange. Invalid or undeletable victims are skipped so a newer victim can still satisfy the box-wide budget. On the first victim that frees bytes it increments evictions and returns the freed bytes.

Head behavior: this loop moves into SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest(index:) with a closure that calls retireIndexedEntries. That helper is not in the supplied source. It is unverified whether it preserves three properties: abort on externalChange, skipping undeletable victims, and a loop bounded by the snapshot. A regression in any of them could affect the T-041 box-wide LRU disk-budget mitigation (availability or over-eviction, not confidentiality). Crypto, HMAC naming, TTL and salt scoping are untouched by this diff.

Unchanged context examined:
- sweepExpiredEntries (base 1848) and scanOnDisk (base 1863-1964): symlink and safe-root checks, binding checks, TTL drops.
- performIndexedRemoval ownsEvictionRoot gating (base 2011).
- settleDurableDonation: verifies durable blocks are readable before issuing a receipt.
- Head lifecycle/close, lookup ticket pinning (head 543-576) and endAdoption reservation release (head 616-651). These appear unchanged.

No regression is evidenced. Integration should still review SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.evictOldest for parity with the base semantics.
